card.name: Quantity of supply after a time span
card.fires_on: The word right after a time span or amount that names how much is provided, such as supply, 's, worth, or equivalent to. It is strongest on 'supply' after '7-day' or 'three-day'.

modes.label: Supply after a duration
modes.description: The word 'supply' or a possessive 's after a number of days or a year.
modes.example: a bottle of SYNAREL provides about a 7-day<< supply>> (about 56 sprays).

modes.label: Equivalent to an amount
modes.description: A linking word such as 'to' after equivalent or corresponding, followed by a dose or volume.
modes.example: remove the volume equivalent<< to>> the amount of the LUMVOA
